neighbours.label: The word completing a split/divide action (apart, into, parts): dividing something into pieces, as opposed to joining
fire: The teacher divided the class into four small groups.
Cut the dough apart and shape each piece into a ball.
The report is split into three parts that cover each region.
The empire broke up into several rival kingdoms.
Break the chocolate bar into pieces before melting it.
The river splits into two channels near the delta.
Separate the eggs and divide the yolks into two bowls.
quiet: The teacher combined the four small groups into one class.
Press the dough together and shape it into one ball.
The report merges data from every region in one table.
The rival kingdoms united under a single empire.
Melt the chocolate bar slowly before using it.
The two channels join near the delta.
Mix the eggs and pour the batter into one bowl.

notes: Card: 'split your payment apart', s.split("-"), 'divided itself into', 'divided into four parts that', 'Split %s into %i parts'; the output suppresses separate/separation. Near misses are the joining side.
